verses.text: Ha sk'ayb'ub'al winhaj Salomón, haton winh yuninal winhaj David sreyal Israel.
Ix tz'ib'chajkan juntzanh lolonel tik yik wach' snachajel jelanil yet' k'ayb'ub'al, yik skolwaji, yik wach' snachajel juntzanh lolonel ay yelk'och ku'uj.
Yuj chi' syal ko b'eyb'alan jelanil, wach'ilal yet' tojolal icha wal yaji.
In gana to sjelanb'i spensar heb' kelemtak, heb' mantalaj spensar, to tz'ak'ji yojtakejel heb', yik syil sb'a heb'.
Yab'okab' juntzanh tik heb' ay spensar yik wach' ste ojtakejel heb'. Yab'okab' pax heb' jelan yik wach' ste jelanb'i heb' yuj.
Ha juntzanh lolonel tik skolwaj ket'ok yik snachajel ku'uj tas syalelk'och juntzanh lolonel satub'tak yet' ajaltak, haton tas syal heb' jelan.
Tato sko nib'ej jelan tzonh aji, aynhejokab' yelk'och Jehová t'a ko sat. Tato sko nib'ej manh pensaril jun, ko patikejokab' el jelanil yet' k'ayb'ub'al tz'alchaji.
Ach wuninal, cha ab' a k'ayb'ub'al swala', manh a patikejel razón syak' ix a nun t'ayach.
Yujto a juntzanh ko k'ayb'ub'al tik ol b'o a b'eyb'al yuj, icha wal junok mach te wach' tz'aj sb'o'an sb'a yet' spichul.
Tato a heb' chuk sb'eyb'al tzach montanb'ati, manh ach b'atok.
K'inalok ay b'aj syal heb' t'ayach icha tik: Ochanh ket'ok yik wach' b'at ko maklejek t'a yol b'e, yik sko mak'cham junok anima tzek' ta'.
Malaj tas na'an yuj, ol ko yamani, ol ko mak'anchamok.
Ichato chi' b'i'an ol kik'ankan masanil makanhil b'eyumal, ol ko b'ut'an ko pat yuj masanil tas ol kelk'ej chi'.
Kotanh, ochanh ket'ok, ol kak'an ik t'a tastak ol kik'a', k'inalok xchi heb'.
Palta ach wuninal, manh ach b'at yet' heb'. B'esel a b'a t'a yol sb'e heb'.
Yujto haxonhej chukal syak' yip heb' sk'ulani, toxonhej snanon sk'o'ol heb' smak'ancham anima.
Tato syil junok nok' much yem sya'alil, nab'anhej am tz'emi.
Palta a juntzanh winak chi', a sya'alil heb' syak'emi, hanheja' heb' ol smilcham sb'a t'ay.
Ha heb' snib'ej tz'och b'eyumal t'a spatik chukal, ol k'och ijan ol cham heb' yuj schuk b'eyb'al chi'.
Ha t'a yoltak calle, b'aj sja b'e, t'a mercado yet' t'a yalnhej b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima, tzonh yawtej Dios yik syak'an ko razón. Syalan icha tik:
Ha ex kelemtak ex tik, ex mantalaj he pensar, toxonton b'uchumtak ex, ¿b'ak'inh ol eyaktejkan he nib'an he manh pensaril chi'? ¿b'ak'inh ol eyaktejkan he b'uchwaji yet' he patikanel jelanil?
Chaek eyab' tas b'aj ol ex in kacha', tato icha chi', ol wak' in razón t'ayex, ol wak' eyojtakejel in lolonel.
Ha in tik tzex wawtejkoti, palta malaj he gana tze cha eyab'i.
Tze patikejel tas swala', max yal he k'ol tzex kachji.

Yuj chi' ol ex in tzetzej ayik ol ja chukal t'a eyib'anh, ayik ol ja xiwk'olal, ya'elal, ilk'olal yet' kusk'olal t'a eyib'anh, icha tz'aj sja junok chakxuxum ik' slajanel masanil tastak. Ayik wan he cham yuj xiwelal chi', toxonhej ol in b'uchwaj t'ayex.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', ol ex te awaj t'ayin, palta manhxo ol in tak'woklaj t'ayex. Ol eyal he b'a t'ayin, palta manh ol wab'laj.
Yujto tze patikejel jelanil, malaj he gana ay welk'och t'a he sat,
malaj he gana tzeyab' tas swala', tze patikejel he kachnab'il swak'a',
yuj chi' ol eyab' sya'il yuj he b'eyb'al chi', ol ex somchajcha'anh yuj.
Ha heb' mantalaj spensar, ol cham heb' yuj smanh pensaril. Ol satel heb' chuk spensar, yujto malaj yelk'och razón tz'ak'ji t'a heb'.
Haxo pax heb' scha'an yab' tas swala', junk'olal ol aj heb', malaj b'aj ol xiw heb', xchi Dios.
